source_statement: [3] Let ABC be an equilateral triangle. Let Ω be its incircle (circle inscribed in the triangle) and let ω be a circle tangent externally to Ω as well as to sides AB and AC. Determine the ratio of the radius of Ω to the radius of ω.

clause_ledger.source: omega tangent to AB and AC
